description: Sprint 6: Export (PDF/ZIP), Auto-Save Session (IndexedDB), Text Search in Bubbles, Multi-Select in Sidebar. Installs jspdf+jszip, creates new branch feature/alpha-sprint6, implements all 4 features, commits, pushes, and opens PR against main.
steps: Create branch feature/alpha-sprint6 from current HEAD (feature/alpha-sprint5). Run: git checkout -b feature/alpha-sprint6
Install new dependencies: npm install jspdf jszip && npm install -D @types/jspdf (jszip has built-in types)

Create features/viewer/exportService.ts with two functions: exportAsPdf(images: ProcessedImage[], renderPage: RenderPageFn) and exportAsZip(images: ProcessedImage[], renderPage: RenderPageFn). RenderPageFn takes a ProcessedImage and returns Promise<HTMLCanvasElement>. For PDF: use jsPDF, iterate pages, call renderPage, add each as image to PDF (A4 or fit to image ratio). For ZIP: use JSZip, iterate pages, call renderPage, convert to blob via toBlob, add each to zip, trigger download.

Create a shared renderPageToCanvas function (in exportService.ts or a helper) that reuses the same rendering logic from downloadCanvas.ts but returns the canvas instead of downloading. Extract the core rendering into a reusable function (renderToCanvas) and refactor downloadCanvas.ts to call it internally.

In App.tsx sidebar footer area (after the 'Minha Biblioteca' button or near it), add two buttons when history has at least one 'done' page: 'Exportar PDF' and 'Exportar ZIP'. These call the new export functions. Pass the current viewer settings (defaultFont, globalBold, globalItalic, globalBubbleScale, isBubbleTransparent, showTextStroke). Show a toast on success/failure.

In services/imageStorage.ts: bump DB_VERSION to 3. Add a new object store 'session' in onupgradeneeded. Add functions: saveSession(sessionData: SessionSnapshot), loadSession(): Promise<SessionSnapshot|null>, clearSession(). SessionSnapshot = { history: Array<{id, fileName, imageUrl, base64, bubbles, status, maskDataUrl?, translatedImageUrl?, errorMessage?}>, currentImageId: string|null, savedAt: number }.

In store/useSessionStore.ts: add a subscribe listener (zustand subscribe) that debounces (300ms) and calls saveSession whenever history or currentImage changes. Only save images that have meaningful data (skip if history is empty). On init (useEffect in App.tsx or a new hook), call loadSession and if data exists, restore it into the session store via replaceHistory + setCurrentImage. Show toast 'Sessao anterior restaurada (X paginas)'.
Add a 'Limpar Sessao' button in the sidebar footer (near Library button) that calls clearSession() and clears the current session store (clearHistory). Show toast on success.

Create components/BubbleSearch.tsx: a floating search panel that appears on Ctrl+F (prevent browser default). Has an input field for search text. Searches through all images' bubbles (originalText + translatedText) case-insensitively. Shows results as a list: image filename + bubble snippet. Clicking a result navigates to that page (setCurrentImage) and could highlight the bubble. Close with Escape or X button.
Register the Ctrl+F keyboard handler in App.tsx (or in a useEffect within BubbleSearch). Render <BubbleSearch /> in App.tsx when open.

Add multiSelect state to App.tsx: selectedIds: Set<string>, isMultiSelectMode: boolean. Ctrl+Click on sidebar items toggles selection. Show a checkbox overlay on selected items. When items are selected, show a floating action bar at the bottom of the sidebar with buttons: 'Traduzir Selecionadas' (for idle/error items), 'Retraduzir Selecionadas' (for done items), 'Deletar Selecionadas', 'Exportar Selecionadas (ZIP)'. Add 'Selecionar Todas' / 'Limpar Selecao' buttons. Exit multi-select with Escape or when all deselected.
Run npm run typecheck && npm run build to verify everything passes.
Commit all changes with message: 'feat: sprint 6 - export PDF/ZIP, auto-save session, bubble search, multi-select sidebar'
Push branch and open PR against main with descriptive title and body.
acceptance_criteria: npm run typecheck passes with zero errors
npm run build produces dist/ successfully
jspdf and jszip are in package.json dependencies
features/viewer/exportService.ts exists with exportAsPdf and exportAsZip functions
services/imageStorage.ts has DB_VERSION=3 with session store and save/load/clear functions
Session auto-save logic is wired (subscribe or effect)
components/BubbleSearch.tsx exists with Ctrl+F handler and search functionality
Sidebar multi-select with Ctrl+Click, floating action bar, and batch actions exist
Branch feature/alpha-sprint6 is pushed with PR open against main
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run build
findings: All 4 features implemented successfully. handleRetranslate from useTranslatePipeline takes no args (operates on currentImage only), so batch retranslate resets items to idle first then calls handleTranslateImage. jspdf types are bundled (no @types/jspdf needed). DB_VERSION bumped to 3 with session store. renderToCanvas extracted as reusable function for export service.
